claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SQ-22536 is a weak, non-competitive adenylyl cyclase inhibitor (IC50 ~13 uM in platelets) that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells through cAMP-pathway inhibition; any observed antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect nonspecific cytotoxicity, but at this low concentration the compound is expected to be largely inactive.
